whatsappAI.title: WhatsApp AI SaaS
whatsappAI.description: Multi-tenant SaaS with a real tool-using AI agent instead of a fixed workflow: 12 tools, 5 of them writing, so the agent books, reschedules and cancels against the live calendar. Business rules — booking ownership, cancellation window, deposit policy — are enforced in the tool layer, not in the prompt. Intent-based tool routing, WhatsApp webhook with HMAC-SHA256 validation and idempotency on Upstash Redis, failover across 3 LLM providers (Groq / Gemini / OpenAI) and deferred jobs with QStash. Stripe + MercadoPago + Paddle + PayPal payments covering Uruguay and LATAM, transactional email with Resend. Custom eval suite of 11 cases and 26 assertions against agent regressions, plus 223 unit tests with Vitest. Stack: Next.js 16 + React 19 + tRPC v11 + NextAuth v5 + Prisma.

arbibuy.title: Arbix — Multi-marketplace Arbitrage Platform
arbibuy.description: SaaS on its own domain (getarbix.com) that finds resale opportunities across Amazon, Walmart and Alibaba. Product radar with live rankings and deep-link notifications, opportunity scoring engine (margin, competition, price stability), proprietary price-history tracking, multi-marketplace profit calculator (US, ES, MX, JP, DE, UK, FR, IT, BR) with real FBA fees by category and weight. Listing Studio with AI image generation, trend analysis with Google Trends, watchlist, investment tracker and weekly summary emails. Multi-layer caching (client + Upstash Redis) to protect third-party API quotas. Full i18n (EN/ES), Free / Pro $99 / Elite $199 plans, auth with Supabase + RLS and Vercel cron pipelines.
